title: Tantalum
description: &6Tantalum&r is a material needed for the creation of some items, most importantly &6Capacitor Boards&r. Tantalum Polycrystal production requires &6Coltan&r which can be located by the use of a &6Coltass&r. It points to the center of a large area where coltan ore can spawn. Tantalum can be obtained from using &bHigh-Performance Solvent&r on &eHeavy Metal Bedrock Ore&r.
&2Coltan Processing at its early stage can provide Niobium needed for Catalytic Cracking Towers.
